correctness.rationale: PASS for even N>=4 identical-frequency globally coupled discrete-time Kuramoto–Sakaguchi and regular Z1=0, rho=|Z2|<1. Differentiation at Z1=0 yields J=I+(K/N)Q R_alpha Q^T, with Gram G=N^-1 Q^T Q positive, tr G=1, det G=(1-rho^2)/4. Thus N−2 unit tangent multipliers and normal lambda±=1+(K/2)(cos alpha ± sqrt(rho^2−sin^2 alpha)). The three exact Jury inequalities give strict normal contraction iff cos alpha<0, K>0 and K<K_c; K_c=-4cos alpha/(1−rho^2) below rho=|sin alpha| and 4/(−cos alpha+sqrt(rho^2−sin^2 alpha)) above it. These branches rise/fall, with max 4/(−cos alpha), including the sin alpha=0 endpoint nuance. Every rho<1 is realized by antipodal pairs. At alpha=2pi/3, phases (0,pi/6,pi,7pi/6) and K=4 the normal matrix is exactly [[0,0],[-2sqrt(3),0]], nonzero with square zero; this is derivative-only cancellation, NOT nonlinear finite-time extinction. Independently recomputed exact Gram and Jordan nilpotence.
